# What falls back, and why

Of the 1,670 formulas of the test corpus that Typst 0.15.1 renders, Typlet lays out 1,504 as HTML, draws 158 as MathML with a warning, and refuses 8. The corpus (test/corpus/README.md) holds the examples of Typst's documentation, the formulas of TypstPad's symbol picker, a formula for each symbol of the `sym` module, and the test cases of Typlet's features and embedded code, so symbols weigh heavily in it. This page is generated from it by tools/site/fallbacks.mjs.

## Drawn as MathML

The `htmlAndMathml` and `html` outputs draw a formula as MathML, which the browser lays out, when Typlet's layout can't draw something in it. The warning, of kind `fallback`, says what, and `renderToResult` returns it with `drawnAs: 'mathml'`.

| Reason | Formulas | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| Typlet does not support "…" in HTML output, as New Computer Modern Math has no glyph for it | 136 | `afghani`, `baht`, `ballot` |
| Typlet does not support raw in HTML output yet | 10 | `#auto`, `#true`, `#1em` |
| Typlet does not support bold "…" in HTML output yet | 2 | `#strong[$x + 1$]`, `1#strong["a"]` |
| Typlet does not support display equations in boxes yet | 2 | `#box[$ x $]`, `#box[a $ x $ b]` |
| Typlet does not support the font "…" in HTML output | 2 | `#show math.equation: set text(font: "Cambria Ma…`, `#text(font: "Arial")[text]` |
| Typlet does not support linebreak in boxes in HTML output yet | 1 | `#box[#hide[a] \ b]` |
| Typlet does not support OpenType features in HTML output yet | 1 | `#text(features: ("ss01",))[ag0]` |
| Typlet does not support parbreak in boxes in HTML output yet | 1 | `#box[a ⏎ ⏎ b]` |
| Typlet does not support right-to-left text in HTML output yet | 1 | `#text(lang: "ar")[(a)]` |
| Typlet does not support text strokes in HTML output yet | 1 | `#text(stroke: 0.5pt + red, $x$)` |
| Typlet does not support the font weight 400 in HTML output yet | 1 | `#text(weight: "regular")[ab]` |

## Refused

A formula with code Typlet doesn't evaluate throws a `TypletError` of kind `unsupported`, which the `fallback` option can render another way, for example with Typst compiled to WebAssembly.

| Reason | Formulas | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| Typlet does not support `show` rules for text | 2 | `#show math.equation: set text(fill: blue) ⏎ #sh…`, `#[#show "x": "y" ⏎ x]` |
| Typlet does not support `show` rules for `strong` | 1 | `#show strong: set text(fill: red) #strong[x]` |
| Typlet does not support `show` rules with a function | 1 | `#show math.equation: it => it x` |
| Typlet does not support `where()` with the field `numbering` | 1 | `#show math.equation.where(numbering: none): set…` |
| Typlet does not support headings | 1 | `#[= Heading]` |
| Typlet does not support loops | 1 | `#for i in (1, 2) [#i]` |
| Typlet does not support the `range` function | 1 | `#let m = range(1, 5).map(i => range(1, 5).map(j…` |
